_doc: Things in Vellmar that spells can change (design/open-world/interactions.md §5). r: radius in sim px (it blocks walking); h: height in metres; mass: how far a shove sends it (lighter goes further); roll: keeps rolling (barrels); burns: seconds a fire lasts before it leaves ash; spread: sim px within which a fire catches other burnable things. Lamps and braziers are lit by fire and put out by water. A burning prop hurts enemies standing in it (dps). material (data/materials.json) and hp (structure: an Impact at or above the break grade takes its impact off, and at 0 it breaks); break and fire override the material's grades (N-4.1). salvage: the reagents a broken prop leaves (economy spec §5.1), picked up when you are within salvage_reach (N-5.2).

barrel._doc: iron-banded staves: breaks at Impact II, catches only at Fire II (grade I smoulders it)

post._doc: a timber prop holding up a structure (data/world/structures.json): breaks at Impact II (a grade I hit cracks it, the next breaks it); burnt to ash, it fails too

_ow2_doc: OW2 (interactions.md §5). Lightning (the zap or beam a Spark or Arc Lance leaves) flares the iron lamps it passes for flare_s seconds and charges the puddles it touches for charge_s; a charged puddle shocks every enemy standing in it (shock_damage every shock_every seconds). rewind_r: how far round a Rewind's shard it mends burnt and shoved props back to how they were. light_r: a lit (or flaring) lamp's pool, which light_shy enemies won't step into.
